items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, rights-dependent display, alerts, affiliate use, advertising, or monetization expansion. Conditional for ordinary bounded reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch or permission request. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private; keep outreach unsent; permit only read-only evidence work and containment. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, caching, public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, price, trademark, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; current public terms restrict the proposed uses. Accuracy/freshness, security/release, measurement/attribution, and owner gates remain blocked. Fleet compliance is technical-only at 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics and attribution remain yellow/partial; missing telemetry is not independently treated as a legal blocker. Revenue remains $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and unattributed; no ROI, margin, payback, forecast, or causal-lift claim is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, and support records; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task is closable. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence. Do not change production, tracking, credentials, configuration, alert scope, monetization, launch state, or send outreach.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion/correction/access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional review. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log/vendor/incident inventory. No item is clear or approved for monetization or public exposure.

Fleet compliance disposition: no fleet-wide legal clearance. The technical baseline reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Remediate or evidence each affected site before public exposure or monetization changes; preserve unknowns where the site was unreachable. Ordinary growth may continue conditionally when it does not add data collection, alter disclosures, introduce unsupported claims, reuse unverified content or imagery, or expand monetization. Do not infer adult, regulated, age-sensitive, copyright, trademark, or platform-policy status from domain names alone.

Continue containment-only execution. Do not create or requeue production, deployment, telemetry, dependency, spending, monetization, or external-outreach work. Continue only existing launch-readiness evidence, security evidence, parked-site verification, attribution reconciliation, and repair-or-close work. Next legal evidence action is the consolidated SearchWoot read-only bundle; no launch task should be closed until its stated evidence is attached and reviewed.

Continue the approved private launch gate and consolidated read-only evidence work. Keep rights-dependent exposure, monetization, deployment, and external outreach paused pending human-counsel review and completion of the four open launch-readiness tasks.
